21.name: Blossom Dust
21.why: The faint powder that drifts off the trees when the wind comes through my window in spring.

21.name: Dawn Petal
21.why: The first soft light on a petal, the way the sky in a picture book wakes up slowly.

21.name: Pillowcase
21.why: The pillowcase my head sinks into every night, soft and faintly rosy from the wash.

22.name: Lamplight
22.why: The warm square of light on the ceiling while someone reads me one more page.

22.name: Beeswax
22.why: The pale wax of the little candle we light for the last story of the night.

22.name: Nightlight
22.why: The small glow that stays on in the hall so the dark feels friendly and far away.
